errors.UNEXPECTED: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

errors.GENERIC: The operation failed (error {{status}}). Reference to give to support: {{reference}}.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Incorrect email or password. After 5 failed attempts, the account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.INVALID_CODE: Incorrect code, or code already used.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the rights needed for this action.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item does not exist or is no longer accessible.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.PAYMENT_REQUIRED: Your subscription has ended: the account is read-only. Choose a plan under "Subscription".
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This lot cannot move to that status from its current status.
errors.LOT_NOT_AVAILABLE: One of the lots is no longer available for a pickup.
errors.LOT_IN_PICKUP: One of the lots is already in a pickup in progress.
errors.LOT_NOT_TRANSFORMABLE: This lot can no longer be split or grouped.
errors.LOT_NOT_WEIGHABLE: This lot can no longer be reweighed: it is already committed to a pickup.
errors.LOT_VERSION_CONFLICT: This lot was changed in the meantime. Reload it before trying again.
errors.SPLIT_WEIGHT_GAP: The weight difference exceeds 2 %: add a comment to explain it.
errors.GROUP_MIXED_LOTS: Lots to group must be from the same site, of the same type and of the same hazard status.
errors.PROVIDER_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This provider cannot be chosen: it is not an active partner or has no valid accreditation on the planned date.
errors.INVALID_PICKUP_TRANSITION: This action is not possible in the current state of the pickup.
errors.VARIANCE_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED: The weight variance must be acknowledged before closing the pickup.
errors.TREATMENT_MISSING: The provider has not yet declared the treatment of every lot received.
errors.PICKUP_NOT_PRICEABLE: Prices are entered once the lots have been collected.
errors.SITE_HAS_STOCK: This site still holds lots: evacuate them before closing it.
errors.WASTE_TYPE_HAS_STOCK: Lots of this type are still in stock.
errors.THRESHOLD_EXISTS: A limit of the same kind already exists for this site, zone and type. The same stock may have one limit by weight, one in pieces, one in volume and one per packaging — not two of the same kind.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the company.
errors.INVITATION_PENDING: An invitation is already pending for this address.
errors.LAST_ADMINISTRATOR: The company must keep at least one active administrator.
errors.ROLE_IN_USE: This role is still assigned to users or invitations.
errors.NO_HAZARDOUS_LOTS: This pickup contains no hazardous waste: no tracking slip is required.
errors.MANIFEST_CODE_MISSING: A hazardous lot has no waste code: complete the waste type first.
errors.MANIFEST_PICKUP_NOT_READY: The tracking slip is drawn up once the provider has confirmed the pickup.
errors.NOT_YOUR_TURN: This tracking slip is waiting for another party's signature.
errors.MANIFEST_NOT_SIGNABLE: This tracking slip is no longer waiting for a signature.
errors.DECLARATION_LOCKED: This declaration is validated: it can no longer be changed.
errors.DECLARATION_FORMAT_UNAVAILABLE: No declaration format is configured for this country yet.
errors.REPORT_TOO_LARGE: Too many rows for this format: shorten the period or use the Excel export.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_PAYABLE: This invoice can no longer receive a payment.
errors.CERTIFICATE_PICKUP_NOT_READY: The certificate is uploaded once the lots have been collected.
errors.INVALID_COMPANY_TRANSITION: A decision has already been made for this company.
errors.ACCREDITATION_ALREADY_REVIEWED: This accreditation already has that status.
errors.DEVICE_REVOKED: This device was revoked by an administrator.
errors.COLOR_IN_USE: This colour is used by lots, waste types, raw materials or zones. Withdraw it from the list instead.
errors.RECEIVED_LOT_IN_USE: The number of a received lot cannot change once an order or a waste lot names it.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_EXCEEDED: The authorisation does not cover this pickup: one of its limits would be exceeded. Each limit is detailed on the Authorisations page.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_UNVERIFIABLE: The authorisation cannot be verified: some lots have no measured weight. Weigh them, then try again.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_PACKAGING: The authorisation is stated in packages only and some lots are loose or in a packaging it does not name: it cannot be verified for them.
errors.AUTHORIZATION_MISSING: No authorisation covers this waste on this date. Record one before requesting the pickup.
errors.providerRequirement: {{provider}} does not take this collection as it stands — {{problems}}
errors.providerRequirementOverridable: {{provider}} does not take this collection as it stands — {{problems}} You may send it all the same by giving the reason.
errors.PROVIDER_REQUIREMENT_NEEDS_AUTHORIZATION: Only an authorised person may send a request despite a blocking requirement of the provider.
errors.PARTNER_NOT_LINKED: This partner has no account: its requirements are simply edited.
errors.REGULATORY_CODE_MISSING: A hazardous waste type of this pickup has no regulatory code: complete it on the waste type, its tracking slip cannot be issued without it.
errors.NO_REQUIREMENT_EXCEPTION: No blocking requirement is waiting for an explanation on this pickup.
errors.ALREADY_ANSWERED: The receiver has already answered: the pickup now waits for the transporter.
errors.AWAITING_RECEIVER: The receiver has not set the date yet: the transporter confirms after it.
errors.NOT_THE_TRANSPORTER: This pickup has no transporter other than its receiver.
errors.TRANSPORTER_REQUIRED: This receiver does not come and fetch the waste: choose a transporter.
errors.PARTNER_ROLE_MISMATCH: This provider cannot hold that role: a company that only transports is never the receiver, and the transporter must be recorded as one.
errors.LOT_LISTED: This lot is offered on the bourse: withdraw the listing, or wait for its deal.
errors.LISTING_LOTS_INVALID: The lots of a listing must exist and be on its site.
errors.LISTING_MIXED_WASTE: A listing offers one waste type: make one listing per type.
errors.LISTING_CLOSED: This listing is closed: it can no longer be changed.
errors.LISTING_LOTS_FIXED: The lots of a published listing no longer change: withdraw it and publish another one.
errors.LISTING_NOT_DRAFT: This listing is already published or closed.
errors.LISTING_CLOSING_PASSED: The closing date is past: choose another one, or none.
errors.LISTING_NOT_OPEN: This listing no longer accepts offers.
errors.NEGOTIATION_OPEN: You are already negotiating this listing: answer in your negotiation.
errors.PROPOSAL_NOT_YOUR_TURN: The last proposal is yours: it waits for the answer of the other side.
errors.PROPOSAL_SUPERSEDED: A new proposal arrived in the meantime: read it before answering.
errors.PROPOSAL_EXPIRED: This proposal is no longer valid: answer with a proposal of your own.
errors.PROPOSAL_OUTDATED: The lots changed since this proposal: it cannot be accepted as it is.
errors.BUYER_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This buyer may not take this waste today: a valid accreditation and the waste among its accepted wastes are required.
errors.NOT_THE_BUYER: Only the buyer withdraws its offer; the seller refuses it.
errors.PICKUP_DATE_TOO_EARLY: The lots cannot be collected yet on that date.
errors.LOT_COMPOSITION_FROZEN: This lot has left the site: its pickup and its tracking slip keep the composition it left with.
errors.CONTRACT_TERMINATED: This contract is terminated: it can no longer be changed.
errors.CONTRACT_NOT_DRAFT: This contract is already in force or terminated.
errors.CONTRACT_NOT_ACTIVE: This contract is not in force.
errors.CONTRACT_OVERLAP: Another contract already covers this provider, in this role and on this site, on some of these dates: terminate it or change the dates.
errors.CONTRACT_PRICE_TWICE: A waste type has one price per contract (and one "any other waste" line at most).
errors.CONTRACT_PACE_DAYS: With chosen days there is one pickup per chosen day: the number of pickups must be the number of days.

lots.title: Waste lots
lots.subtitle: Each lot is identified by a QR code and followed to its final destination.
lots.emptyHint: Lots are created at the workshop, from the mobile app or this button.
lots.splitHint: The original lot is closed and replaced by the new lots, each with its own label.
lots.groupHint: The selected lots are closed and replaced by a single lot with a new label.
lots.qrHint: The QR code on the label identifies this lot. Without a reader, type its number: {{number}}.

zoneMismatch.type: This zone is not meant for this waste type. You can still continue.
zoneMismatch.color: This zone is not meant for this colour. You can still continue.

lots.productionOrderHint: Optional. The stage is deduced from the zone, the raw material from the order.
lots.originHint: Where this lot comes from in production. Leave empty what you do not know: the stage is deduced from the zone, the raw material from the order.
lots.countedHint: This waste is declared by quantity, not by weight.
lots.weightComputed: Left empty, the weight is computed from the quantity.
lots.weightUnknown: Left empty, the weight stays unknown: it is not estimated.
lots.weighLaterHint: Leave empty if the lot is not weighed yet: its weight will stay "to be weighed", never zero.
lots.weightEstimated: This weight is an estimate, not a weighing
lots.packageCountHint: One lot may hold several bags, bales or boxes. Left empty: 1 package, marked "default".
lots.packagesOnSite: Give the real number of packages of the lot. A pickup being prepared takes this number.
lots.packagesAfterDeparture: The lot has left the site: this is a correction. The number the pickup and the authorisation were decided with is kept; the corrected number is shown beside it and recorded in the history.
lots.packagesDefaultHint: The current number is a default: nobody has confirmed it yet.
lots.splitPackagesHint: The original lot counts {{count}} package(s): give the packages of each new lot, as you count them.
lots.groupPackages: Number of packages of the grouped lot
lots.groupPackagesHint: Count the result: three lots put in one bale are one package. Left empty: 1, as a default.
lots.compositionDefault: If nothing is entered, the lot takes the composition of its type: {{label}}.
lots.compositionHint: Add the materials if you know them (label, supplier sheet, what the workshop knows). Otherwise leave it empty.
lots.compositionEditHint: What the lot is made of, material by material, totalling 100 %. No need to follow raw materials or production: say what you know of the lot. A pickup that has not left follows the new composition; it is printed on the tracking slip.

compositionSource.waste_type: Default of the waste type — to be checked
compositionSource.split: Kept from the lot it was split from

lots.weightBasisLabel: How do you know this weight?
lots.differentSites: Lots from several sites: choose lots of one site
lots.cannotGroup: Only lots of the same site, type and hazard can be grouped.

import.title: Import lots
import.subtitle: From a register kept in Excel or an export of your ERP, one line per lot.
import.lead: One line per lot. The site and the waste type are needed; the weight, date, zone, packaging and your reference are optional. Without a zone, the lot goes to the storage area of its site. A line whose reference was already imported is not created twice.
import.daviTip: Simpler: drop this file on the virtual assistant. It checks every line and asks for your agreement before importing.

stock.title: Waste stock
stock.subtitle: Calculated in real time from the lots present on site.
stock.emptyHint: Stock appears as soon as a lot is created on a site.
stock.noThreshold: No limit defined. A limit warns you before a zone or a site holds too much waste.
stock.misplacedHint: The waste type or the colour of these lots is not planned in this zone.
stock.limitsHint: A limit is a maximum quantity — in t, kg, m³, l or packages — for a whole site, a zone or a waste type. You are alerted as it gets close, then again if it is exceeded.
stock.limitIntro: Choose what the limit watches (a site, a zone, a waste type) and in which unit: weight, pieces, volume or number of packages. The same stock may have several limits, for example a weight and a number of bags; each is evaluated separately.
stock.maxHint: Quantity not to exceed, in the unit chosen.
stock.warningHint: You are warned when the stock reaches this percentage of the limit.

scope.siteType: this type on the whole site

stock.unconfirmed: {{count}} lot(s) with a default number of packages
stock.unconfirmedHint: These lots count as one package for want of a figure. Correct their number of packages if they hold several.
stock.maxHintPackages: Number of packages not to exceed: a whole number. A lot of 12 bags counts as 12.
stock.unitHint: Pieces and volumes are offered only when this waste type is counted that way, or states the weight of a piece or its density.
stock.unitHintAnyType: For all waste types, the limit is counted by weight or in packages. Choose a waste type for a limit in pieces or in volume.
stock.packagingCountedHint: Only the packages of this packaging are counted. Loose lots and lots in another packaging are not concerned; they are pointed out.
stock.unitFixed: The unit of a limit cannot be changed. To watch the same stock in another unit, add another limit: each has its own answer.
stock.limitPreview: {{where}}: alert when the stock of "{{what}}" exceeds {{max}} {{unit}}, and from {{pct}} % of that limit. No lot is refused.
stock.limitPreviewAll: {{where}}: alert when the stock, all waste together, exceeds {{max}} {{unit}}, and from {{pct}} % of that limit. No lot is refused.
stock.limitOutside: {{count}} other lot(s) of the scope, loose or in another packaging than {{packaging}}: not concerned by this limit.
stock.noSiteLimit: No limit on the whole site

sites.title: Sites and zones
sites.subtitle: Your production sites and their workshop and storage zones.
sites.emptyHint: Create your first site to start recording lots.
sites.closeHint: The site stays in the history and in documents; it is no longer offered for new lots.
sites.capacityHint: One line per packaging the zone takes, with how many packages it holds when it holds only that one. The lines describe one shared room. A loose lot or one in a packaging not listed is reported, never converted.
sites.capacityKgLimit: Maximum load of the zone (kg), optional
sites.reservedHint: Optional. A lot that does not match is reported, never refused.
sites.siteLoadHint: Every lot on the site, each counted once whatever its zone.
sites.capacityM3Required: Enter the volume of the zone, above 0.
sites.volumeHint: The room taken is the sum of the volumes of the lots: number of packages × volume of one package ("Volume of one package" button on the Sites page), else the measured volume of a loose lot, else its weight ÷ the density of its waste type. A lot whose volume is not known is reported, never estimated.
sites.packagingVolumesHint: Only used by zones whose room is measured in volume (m³): the room a lot takes = number of packages × volume of one package. Leave empty what you do not know: those lots are reported "no known volume", never estimated.
sites.packagingVolumesInvalid: A volume must be a number above 0 (4 decimals at most), or empty.
sites.inactiveVolume: Volume on record, not used: {{m3}} m³.
sites.inactiveVolumeHint: Some zones of this site have a volume (m³) on record while their room is measured in packages. Open the site to review them.
sites.inactiveVolumeBanner: {{count}} zone(s) have a volume (m³) on record that is not used: their room is measured in packages. Nothing was erased. Open each zone ("Review") and choose "Volume (m³)" if that volume really is the capacity of the zone; otherwise leave it in packages.
sites.inactiveVolumeInForm: A volume of {{m3}} m³ is on record for this zone and is not used: its room is measured in packages. Choose "Volume (m³)" above to use it. It stays on record as long as you do not change it.
sites.siteLimitNote: A site has no capacity of its own: to watch everything it holds, set a stock limit on the whole site (every zone, every waste type), in t, kg, m³, l or packages.
sites.siteLimitLink: Set a limit on the site
sites.sharedRoom: One room, shared: the zone holds {{lines}}, or a mix — for instance {{half}}. Each package takes its share.
sites.zonesToCreate: Zones to create with the site
sites.zonesToCreateHint: Each zone chosen is created with the name of its type; adjust them afterwards on the site's page.
sites.zoneMoreSummary: Maximum load, alert at {{pct}} %, zone reserved for some waste
sites.closed: Site “{{name}}” closed: it stays in the history and is no longer offered for new lots.
sites.storageAlways: Created with every site: that is where lots are stored.

wasteTypes.title: Waste types
wasteTypes.subtitle: Activate types from the reference catalogue or create your own.
wasteTypes.frozen: The code, family, waste code and hazard status are frozen after creation: lots and regulatory documents refer to them.
wasteTypes.emptyHint: Activate at least one type from the catalogue to be able to create lots.
wasteTypes.requiresAuthorization: This waste only leaves the site under an authorisation (declaration signed by customs)

stock.title: How to read the stock
stock.text:
Stock is computed at each display from the lots on site: nothing is entered here.
Capacity: what a zone can physically hold — its room (in packages, shared between packagings, or in m³) and its load (kg). It is set on the site page.
Limit: a maximum quantity you set for a whole site, a zone or a waste type (the specification asks for stock "per site, zone and type"), in t, kg, m³, l or packages. You are warned before it is reached, then when it is exceeded.
"No limit" or "Capacity not set" means nothing watches that line: click "Set" to add one.

lots.title: Waste lots
lots.text:
A lot is a weighed quantity of a single waste type, with its QR label. It is created here or from the workshop application.
Its status follows its journey: created, stored, awaiting pickup, collected, treated, closed.
Click a lot to see its full history, its origin in production and the pickup that took it.
Nothing is ever deleted: a corrected lot keeps the trace of the correction.

pickups.title: Pickups
pickups.text:
A pickup groups lots of one site handed to a receiver, with or without a separate transporter.
Stages: draft, requested, confirmed (date set), collected (lots loaded), received (weighed on arrival), closed.
If the receiver has an account, it answers itself. Otherwise you record its stages on the pickup page.
Every waste collected leaves with its tracking slip, issued automatically at loading.

sites.title: Sites and zones
sites.text:
A site is a factory or a warehouse. Each site is divided into zones: workshops, storage areas.
Click a site to manage its zones, their capacity and what they are meant to hold.
A site or a zone is not deleted: it is deactivated, and history keeps pointing to it.

zones.title: The zones of this site
zones.text:
Capacity: the room of a zone is measured one way. In packages: one line per packaging, and the lines describe one shared room — "100 bags, 50 bales" means 100 bags, or 50 bales, or a mix (50 bags and 25 bales). Or in volume (m³). The maximum load (kg) is a separate limit, on its own line. None of them refuses a lot.
The whole site is watched with a stock limit (Stock page), in the unit you choose.
Reserved for: the waste types and colours planned for the zone. A lot that does not match is reported, never refused.
The zone type (cutting, sewing…) is optional; it tells which production step a waste comes from.
"No limit" means the filling of the zone is not watched.

wasteTypes.title: Waste types and colours
wasteTypes.text:
Your waste types come from the catalogue of the platform (Catalogue tab) or are created by you.
The code, family, regulatory code and hazardous flag no longer change after creation: documents rely on them.
Tick "under authorisation" for a waste that can only leave with a customs authorisation.
Default colours are shared; the ones you add are visible to your company only.

providers.title: Providers and partners
providers.text:
Partners without an account: transporters and receivers you record yourself. You enter their stages and they sign by hand.
Providers on the platform: they have an account, answer your requests and sign themselves. Add them to your partners to be able to choose them.
A provider whose accreditation has expired cannot be chosen for a pickup.

register.title: The waste register
register.text:
The register lists each lot produced over the period with its exit: pickup, receiver, weight received, channel.
It is generated from the lots: no line is typed by hand.
Export it as PDF or Excel for an inspection.

manifests.title: Tracking slips
manifests.text:
Every waste collected has its slip, hazardous or not, pre-filled from the pickup.
It is signed in order: producer, transporter, receiver. Each signs with their password, or by hand on the printed slip.
A party without an account signs by hand: print the PDF, have it signed, then "Record the signature".
As soon as one signature is handwritten, attach the scan of the signed copy to close the slip.

declarations.title: Annual declarations
declarations.text:
The declaration of a site for a year is calculated from its lots and pickups.
A draft can be recalculated until it is validated. Once validated, the declaration is frozen and archived.

authorizations.title: Exit authorisations
authorizations.text:
Only waste types marked "under authorisation" are concerned (a checkbox on the waste type).
An authorisation gives a period and a quantity: a weight, a number of lots, or packages per packaging.
Each pickup request reserves its share. Without a valid authorisation or with too little left, the request is blocked.
You are warned when the authorisation is almost used up and before it ends.

productionPartners.title: Clients and suppliers
productionPartners.text:
Clients are those you produce for; suppliers deliver your raw materials.
They only serve to tell where each waste comes from. They are not your waste providers.
Enter them here or import them from a file (Production › Import).

productionCatalog.title: Raw materials and articles
productionCatalog.text:
A raw material carries its composition and colour: the waste that comes from it takes them automatically.
Fill in the width and weight of a fabric to get the waste rate of your manufacturing orders.
An article says what one piece should consume of each raw material: the basis of the planned / actual comparison.

productionOrders.title: Orders
productionOrders.text:
An order lists the articles a client asks for, with quantities.
Manufacturing orders are attached to an order: that link tells for which client a waste was produced.

manufacturingOrders.title: Manufacturing orders
manufacturingOrders.text:
A manufacturing order makes an article. Give its stages and the site of each: it can be cut on one site and sewn on another.
Enter what the order really consumed: the form compares with the plan and flags any excess.
Waste lots are attached to an order when they are created (form or workshop application).
The produced quantity of a finished order feeds the "waste per piece produced" of the dashboard.

productionStats.title: How to read these statistics
productionStats.text:
Measured: the lot names its manufacturing order. This is an exact figure.
Estimated (≈): the lot only says its stage; its weight is shared between the orders at that stage that day, by pieces done.
Not attributed: the lot says nothing. The lower this figure, the more reliable your statistics.
Waste rate: share of the consumed material that became waste. It needs the consumption in kg, or in metres with width and weight.

reports.title: Reports and exports
reports.text:
Choose a report, a period and a format: it is prepared in the background and appears in the list when ready.
A report is visible only to the person who requested it and stays available for 30 days.

productionLots.title: Three kinds of lot, not to be confused
productionLots.text:
Received lot: a delivery of raw material by a supplier. It tells where the material comes from and what it cost.
Produced lot: finished goods made by an order for its client. It has no supplier.
Waste lot: waste from production, managed in Operations → Waste lots.
None of these is a stock: no balance, no location and no movement is kept here.

productionFinance.title: How to read costs and gains
productionFinance.text:
Actual material cost: quantity consumed × cost of the received lot it comes from. A lot used by several orders is shared by what each one consumed.
Estimated material cost: when the lot is not specified, the quantity is valued at the average price of the material — and counted apart.
Value of production: pieces made × price agreed on the order. It is not what was invoiced.
Recorded gain: value of production − recorded costs (materials + other expenses). It is computed only when everything is known; otherwise what is missing is listed.
This is not an accounting result: no overheads, no labour unless entered as an expense. Amounts exclude tax.

marketplace.title: How the bourse works
marketplace.text:
A listing gathers lots in stock of one site and one waste type. From the draft on, these lots are reserved.
Published, it is seen only by providers that accept this waste and hold a valid accreditation. Your name stays hidden unless you choose to show it.
Each buyer negotiates with you in private: it never sees the other buyers' offers. You accept, refuse or make a counter-offer.
The price may be a revenue (the buyer pays) or a cost (you pay the buyer), per tonne, per kilogram or flat.
Accepting creates a draft pickup to that buyer; the agreed price is applied at reception, on the received weight.

marketplaceBuyer.title: How the bourse works
marketplaceBuyer.text:
You see the listings of the waste you accept, as long as your accreditation is valid.
The seller stays anonymous until the deal, unless it chooses to show its name.
Only the seller sees your offer. Each side answers the other's last proposal: accept, counter-offer or refuse.
Once the deal is made, the seller sends you a pickup request as usual, at the agreed price.

contracts.title: How contracts work
contracts.text:
A contract binds your company to a receiver (collector, recycler, sorter) or a transporter, of the platform or without an account.
It sets the prices per waste type (revenue or cost, per tonne, per kilogram or per lot), the fee per pickup and the monthly fee.
It also sets the pace of pickups: what is done, what remains and an overdue pickup are followed.
In force, it applies by itself to the pickups of that provider for that site between its dates: its prices at reception, its fees added.
A provider has one contract in force at a time for one role and one site.
